description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-23. -->
## YouTube

- **Home feed:** Show a channel’s display name instead of its handle when the card identifies the channel. No network lookup is made. On supported 21.x versions, you can also add an **Add to queue** button to eligible thumbnails. It appends the video without starting playback. Both options are off by default. (#80, #83)
- **Video quality button:** Show the current resolution as `LQ`, `SD`, `HD`, `FHD`, `2K`, `4K`, or an exact number. The timestamp no longer duplicates the quality button; turning the button off restores your timestamp settings. (#75)
- **Swipe controls:** Choose separate side and top/bottom overlay styles, including a horizontal bar centered in the player. Customize the overlay background independently of opacity. Optionally enable swipes in the portrait watch player. Swipe icons follow the selected player icon style, and seekbar gestures stay with the native scrubber. (#82)
- **Cast and Companion:** Restore toolbar Cast independently of player Cast. YouTube 21.39.525 and 21.45.90 also have a separate **Hide Companion button** setting. (#81)
- **Default miniplayer:** Hide the overlay buttons, tap the tile to expand, or swipe down to dismiss. Touch exploration retains the native buttons. (#79)
- **Player fixes:** Keep the played gradient visible after the controls fade in dark portrait mode, and keep the dislike count from disappearing during action-row updates. (#71, #78)

## YouTube Music

- **A–B repeat:** Set two points in Now Playing and loop that section. Clear the markers to resume normal playback.
- **Prefer original audio stream:** Prefer a non-DRC stream when one exists for the same audio track. This is independent of **Disable loudness normalization** and does not replace existing downloads.
- **Player settings:** Corrected the icon and text alignment for **Add to queue in tap order** and **Playback source inspector**.

Refresh the RVX patch source in Manager, then repatch and install the app you use.
